title: Physical Damage Aura
wikitext: {{Status |name=Large Physical Damage Aura |icon=Pride skill icon.png |type=Buff |description= Allies Deal Extra Physical Damage |bonuses= #% increased Global Physical Damage }} {{Status |name=Medium Physical Damage Aura |icon=Pride skill icon.png |type=Buff |description= Allies Deal Extra Physical Damage |bonuses= #% increased Global Physical Damage }} '''Medium Physical Damage Aura''' and '''Large Physical Damage Aura''' are [[monster aura]]s. It is similar but not the same as {{il|Pride}} aura. The large aura is granted by a monster modifier [[Modifier:MonsterModPhysicalDamageAura|{{c|mod|of Damaging}}]] (the mod is known as "{{c|normal|Extra Physical Damage Aura}}" under the monster nameplate), which is only available to rare rarity monster. Unique monster's mod may also grant the monster with this aura, such as [[Tormented Cutthroat]],Through [[Modifier:TormentSpiritCutthroat]] mods [[Atziri's Chosen]],Though [[Modifier:MonsterImplicitAuraMediumDamage1]] mod[[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Skeletons/MapSkeletonMeleeKnightElementalBoss]] [[Blood Progenitor]][[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/BloodChieftain/MapMonkeyChiefBloodEnrage2]] and [[Whispering Totem]].[[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Totems/TotemUniqueMapMonsterDamageAndEvasionAuras]] The game also has a subtype of [[totem]] monsters that use this aura as their in-built skill,Through [[Modifier:MonsterTotemAuraDamage1~]] mod despite they share the same names with other totems as either [[Vaal Totem]][[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Totems/TotemMonsterDamage]] or [[Grinning Totem]].[[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Totems/TikiTotemMonsterDamage]] The radius and increased damage values varies from source to source. For example, tormented spirit's aura radius is 4.5 metre, totem is 6 metre, while the monster mod (including Blood Progenitor) is 5 metre. The aura has the same icon as {{il|Pride}} aura. But Pride only affects enemies as a debuff aura, while this monster aura is a buff aura which only affects allies. Pride is causing {{c|mod|Nearby Enemies take at least #% more Physical Damage}} while Physical Damage Aura is causing allies {{c|mod|#% increased Global Physical Damage}}. So that they can stack due to different name and stat. The mod [[Modifier:MonsterModPhysicalDamageAura|Extra Physical Damage Aura]] can be stolen by {{il|Headhunter}}, or {{il|Inspired Learning}} to grant the player the aura as well as player's allies. Player can also affected by this aura when converting any non-unique monsters with this aura skill as friendlies temporarily by using {{il|Conversion Trap}}. ==Gallery== File:Medium Physical Damage Aura beta.jpg|Official game beta screenshot (medium aura)https://web.archive.org/web/20120608140904/http://www.pathofexile.com/monsterauras File:Large Physical Damage Aura beta.jpg|Official game beta screenshot (large aura) ==Version history== The auras originally granted from [[monster modifier]]s [[Modifier:MonsterAuraMediumDamage1|{{c|mod|Medium Physical Damage Aura}}]] or [[Modifier:MonsterAuraLargeDamage1|{{c|mod|Large Physical Damage Aura}}]]. The devs also introduced implicit and unique versions of this mods after the intro of the initial versions, which grant this aura to monster even in normal rarity (e.g. [[Totem]]), or as unique monster. However, the initial versions are spawn disabled since version 3.18.0. The aura was then granted by new [[Archnemesis]] monster mod {{ml|MonsterArchnemesisBonebreaker_}} (rare rarity version only; also known as Bonebreaker in the text under the monster nameplate) from version 3.18 to 3.19 (the Bonebreaker version as league mechanic during game ver.3.17 (Archnemesis league) does not grants aura). The Archnemesis version has different mod value than other versions, which the Archnemesis' (Bonebreaker's) Large Physical Damage Aura grants {{c|mod|40% increased Global Physical Damage}}, as well as other effect that grant to the mod owner of the Bonebreaker mod.{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3267228|title=What's Next for Archnemesis Modifiers |author=Chris|date=May 15, 2022|accessdate=June 18, 2023|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums}} While the old (pre-3.18) monster mods grant 50% increase for large aura and 30% increase for medium aura. The current value of Large Physical Damage Aura from the monster mod is not publicly announced and rely on datamining game files to deduce the values. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| * Monster mods now only do one specific thing. Monster mods now say exactly what they do. }} {{Version history table row|3.18.0| * Archnemesis modifiers have been rebalanced and added to the core game. Existing Magic and Rare monster modifiers have been replaced with Archnemesis modifiers. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0|rel=before| * Introduced to the game. }} {{version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Monster auras]]
